nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
kind: Tin nhắn thoại nhờ hàng xóm thu quần áo
L: Hi Mrs. Lee, it's Hoa from next door. Sorry to bother you!
I've just checked the weather app, and it's going to pour this afternoon.
My clothes are still hanging on the balcony, and I won't be home until six.
Could you ask your son to bring them inside? He has my spare key.
It's getting windy too, so you should close your windows.
I'll pick up some bread on my way home and bring you a loaf.
Thanks a million! You're a lifesaver.
I owe you one. See you tonight!

exq.q: Why is Hoa calling Mrs. Lee?
exq.a: She wants help with her laundry.
w: She wants to borrow a key.
exq.why: “Could you ask your son to bring them inside?” = nhờ thu quần áo.

exq.q: What will the weather be like this afternoon?
w: It will be hot and dry.
exq.why: “it’s going to pour this afternoon” = chiều nay mưa như trút.

exq.q: What will Hoa bring Mrs. Lee?
exq.why: “bring you a loaf” = mang cho cô một ổ bánh mì.
